name: MCP Sentinel GraphQL
description: Extends MCP Sentinel governance (mutation gating, field redaction, audit, schema discovery) to the GraphQL Compose endpoint for MCP requests.
project_description: MCP Sentinel GraphQL is an optional submodule of MCP Sentinel. It brings a GraphQL Compose endpoint under the same governance the base module applies to the MCP Tool and JSON:API planes, for requests on the validated OAuth agent channel. It has no settings of its own: it reads the same policy profiles and Data Loss Prevention settings as the base module. For governed agents it applies field-name redaction (redacted fields become [REDACTED]), classification egress ceilings, DLP value-pattern masking, exfiltration result-count caps, mutation gating, and per-entity read audit to GraphQL responses. Entity allow/deny is already handled by the base module's entity-access hook, and cache contexts (user.roles, oauth2_scopes) keep governed and non-governed responses separate.
